skills.title: Zoom Meeting Setup
skills.summary: Configuring HD video/audio, waiting rooms, passcodes, and scheduling recurring meetings.
skills.bangla: প্রফেশনাল মিটিং শিডিউলিং, এইচডি অডিও/ভিডিও অপ্টিমাইজেশন, ওয়েটিং রুম ও পাসকোড সিকিউরিটি সেটআপ।
skills.tech: Zoom Web Portal, Desktop Client, Outlook/Google Calendar Plugins
skills.spoken: I configure hardened meeting templates with waiting rooms, AES-256 bit encryption, and auto-calendar sync.
skills.interview_q: How do you ensure a recurring executive Zoom meeting is completely secure from unauthorized attendees?
skills.interview_a: I enforce authenticated user logins, mandatory waiting rooms with host-controlled admission, unique meeting IDs instead of PMI, and passcode protection with end-to-end encryption.

skills.title: Zoom Workplace Administration
skills.summary: Enterprise tenant governance, domain verification, SSO (SAML/Okta), and policy enforcement.
skills.bangla: এন্টারপ্রাইজ অ্যাকাউন্ট ম্যানেজমেন্ট, এসএসও (Okta/Azure AD) ইন্টিগ্রেশন ও ওয়ার্কপ্লেস পলিসি প্রয়োগ।
skills.tech: Zoom Admin Portal, SAML 2.0, Okta, Azure AD, SCIM Provisioning
skills.spoken: I manage corporate Zoom tenants with Okta SSO SAML 2.0 and automated SCIM user provisioning.
skills.interview_q: What steps do you take to enforce SSO and SCIM provisioning across a 500-person enterprise?
skills.interview_a: I configure SAML 2.0 with IdP metadata in Zoom Admin Portal, verify corporate domains via DNS TXT records, and map user groups via SCIM attributes for auto-license assignment.

skills.title: Zoom Account Management
skills.summary: Managing multi-tier licensing (Pro, Business, Enterprise), billing, and add-on subscriptions.
skills.bangla: লাইসেন্স অপ্টিমাইজেশন (Pro/Business), অ্যাড-অন ক্যাপাসিটি ম্যানেজমেন্ট ও বিলিং অডিট।
skills.tech: Billing Portal, License Allocation Engine, Add-on Pool (Webinar 500/1000, Large Meeting)
skills.spoken: I audit enterprise license pools to prevent idle seats and provision webinar capacity dynamically.
skills.interview_q: How do you optimize Zoom licensing costs for an agency with rotating seasonal presenters?
skills.interview_a: I set up floating webinar licenses and reassign Pro/Large Meeting add-on tiers via automated admin workflows based on event calendars.

skills.title: Zoom User Management
skills.summary: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), user groups, department tagging, and automated de-provisioning.
skills.bangla: রোল-বেসড অ্যাক্সেস কন্ট্রোল (RBAC), ইউজার গ্রুপ পারমিশন ও অফবোর্ডিং অটোমেশন।
skills.tech: User Management API, RBAC Roles (Owner, Admin, Member, Custom Roles)
skills.spoken: I configure custom RBAC roles so marketing teams can manage webinars without accessing billing or logs.
skills.interview_q: How do you restrict recording deletion privileges while allowing team members to host meetings?
skills.interview_a: By creating a custom role in Zoom Admin with 'Manage Recordings' set to view-only, disallowing hard delete permissions.

skills.title: Zoom Security & Permissions
skills.summary: Watermarking, audio signatures, end-to-end encryption (E2EE), and IP range restrictions.
skills.bangla: ভিজ্যুয়াল ওয়াটারমার্ক, অডিও সিগনেচার, E2EE এনক্রিপশন ও নির্দিষ্ট আইপি রেঞ্জ পারমিশন।
skills.tech: E2EE Cryptography, Visual Watermark, IP Allowlisting, In-meeting Security Toolbar
skills.spoken: I implement visual watermarks with attendee email overlays and enforce IP allowlisting for sensitive calls.
skills.interview_q: What measures protect confidential client presentations against screen leaks during Zoom meetings?
skills.interview_a: We enable individual attendee email visual watermarks, audio signatures, disable local recording, and mandate E2EE.

skills.title: Zoom Recording Management
skills.summary: Cloud recording rules, auto-transcription, auto-deletion retentions, and secure share links.
skills.bangla: ক্লাউড রেকর্ডিং রুলস, অটো-ট্রান্সক্রিপশন, পাসওয়ার্ড প্রোটেকশন ও অটো-ডিলিশন রিটেনশন পলিসি।
skills.tech: Zoom Cloud Storage, Smart Chapters, Retention Policy, AWS S3 Archival
skills.spoken: I configure auto-cloud recording with smart chapters and automated retention pipelines to AWS S3.
skills.interview_q: How do you automate cloud recording archival to avoid exceeding Zoom cloud storage limits?
skills.interview_a: We listen to the 'recording.completed' webhook and push the MP4/VTT files to an AWS S3 bucket, then purge cloud copies after 30 days.

skills.title: Zoom Rooms Configuration
skills.summary: Hardware deployment (Neat, Poly, Logitech), calendar resource mailboxes, and digital signage.
skills.bangla: কনফারেন্স রুম হার্ডওয়্যার সেটআপ (Logitech/Poly), ক্যালেন্ডার রিসোর্স ইন্টিগ্রেশন ও ডিজিটাল সাইনেজ।
skills.tech: Zoom Rooms Controller, Google Workspace / M365 Resource Mailboxes, SIP/H.323 Gateways
skills.spoken: I deploy Zoom Rooms with Microsoft 365 calendar resource mailboxes and one-touch join hardware.
skills.interview_q: How do you link a physical conference room to a Google Workspace calendar for one-touch join?
skills.interview_a: By provisioning a dedicated Google Calendar resource mailbox, sharing delegate access with Zoom Rooms, and pairing the controller.

skills.title: Zoom Phone Setup
skills.summary: Cloud PBX migration, number porting, call queues, emergency address E911, and desk phone provisioning.
skills.bangla: ক্লাউড পিবিএক্স টেলিফোনি, লোকাল নম্বর পোর্টিং, কল কিউ ও ইমার্জেন্সি E911 রাউটিং সেটআপ।
skills.tech: Zoom Phone Native PBX, SIP Trunking, E911 Nomad Routing, Poly/Yealink Provisioning
skills.spoken: I configure Zoom Phone native cloud PBX with multi-level auto-attendants and compliant E911 routing.
skills.interview_q: What is critical when configuring E911 emergency call routing for hybrid remote employees?
skills.interview_a: Enabling Nomadic E911 so the client auto-detects network BSSID and IP subnets to push real-time physical dispatch addresses.

skills.title: Zoom Webinar Setup
skills.summary: Scheduling 500-10,000 attendee webinars, Q&A moderation, practice sessions, and live streaming.
skills.bangla: ৫০০ থেকে ১০,০০০ অডিয়েন্স ওয়েবিনার, প্র্যাকটিস সেশন, প্যানেলিস্ট ম্যানেজমেন্ট ও ইউটিউব/ফেসবুক লাইভ।
skills.tech: Zoom Webinar 500-10k, Practice Session, Q&A Upvoting, Custom RTMP Streaming
skills.spoken: I architect high-capacity webinars with backstage practice sessions, moderated Q&A, and RTMP multicasting.
skills.interview_q: How do you test audio/video with keynote speakers without exposing the session to early attendees?
skills.interview_a: We enable 'Webinar Practice Session', allowing panelist rehearsals in backstage mode before clicking 'Broadcast' to attendees.

skills.title: Zoom Events Management
skills.summary: Multi-day, multi-track hybrid summits, event hubs, expo booths, and ticketing passes.
skills.bangla: মাল্টি-ডে ভার্চুয়াল সামিট, এক্সপো বুথ, টিকিট ভেন্ডিং ও মাল্টি-ট্র্যাক এজেন্ডা কনফিগারেশন।
skills.tech: Zoom Events Hub, Ticket Types (General/VIP), Expo Floor, Session Tracks
skills.spoken: I build multi-track virtual summits in Zoom Events with VIP networking lounges and sponsor booths.
skills.interview_q: How do you configure VIP vs General Admission ticket permissions for a multi-session Zoom summit?
skills.interview_a: Within Zoom Events Hub, I define distinct ticket tiers with role-based access rules mapped to specific track sessions.

skills.title: Webinar Registration Setup
skills.summary: Custom registration questions, approval workflows (manual/automatic), and unique join links.
skills.bangla: কাস্টম রেজিস্ট্রেশন ফর্ম, অটোমেটিক অ্যাপ্রুভাল ফিল্টারিং ও ইউনিক জয়েন লিংক জেনারেশন।
skills.tech: Webinar Registration Engine, Custom Fields, reCAPTCHA, Domain Blocking
skills.spoken: I build custom registration forms with corporate domain validation and automated approved join links.
skills.interview_q: How do you block free email providers (Gmail/Yahoo) on Zoom webinar registrations for B2B leads?
skills.interview_a: By enabling domain restriction in registration settings or validating through an external landing page API webhook before approving.

skills.title: Webinar Landing Page Integration
skills.summary: Embedding Zoom registration widgets on Webflow, WordPress, ClickFunnels, and custom React sites.
skills.bangla: ক্লিকফানেলস, ওয়ার্ডপ্রেস বা ওয়েবফ্লো ল্যান্ডিং পেজে জুম রেজিস্ট্রেশন উইজেট বা এপিআই কানেক্ট করা।
skills.tech: Zoom Embedded Widget, REST API Registrant Endpoint, Webflow/WordPress Webhooks
skills.spoken: I integrate high-converting custom landing pages that push registrant payloads seamlessly to Zoom.
skills.interview_q: Why use a custom landing page instead of default Zoom registration pages?
skills.interview_a: Custom pages enable full brand immersion, custom tracking scripts (GTM/GA4/Meta), higher conversion rates, and split testing.

skills.title: Webinar Branding
skills.summary: Custom banners, speaker headshots, branded virtual backgrounds, and personalized email templates.
skills.bangla: ব্যানার, ব্র্যান্ডেড ভার্চুয়াল ব্যাকগ্রাউন্ড, স্পিকার হেডশট ও কাস্টম কালার প্যালেট ব্র্যান্ডিং।
skills.tech: Zoom Branding Studio, HTML Email Customizer, Virtual Background Presets
skills.spoken: I apply corporate brand guidelines across the webinar console, invitation emails, and speaker lower-thirds.
skills.interview_q: How do you ensure all remote presenters maintain brand consistency on video?
skills.interview_a: By enforcing centrally managed Zoom Virtual Backgrounds and branded lower-third overlays via administrative room controls.

skills.title: Webinar Host & Panelist Management
skills.summary: Assigning co-hosts, managing panelist invites, unmuting controls, and breakout rooms.
skills.bangla: কো-হোস্ট অ্যাসাইনমেন্ট, প্যানেলিস্ট ইনভাইট লিঙ্ক ম্যানেজমেন্ট ও ব্যাকস্টেজ কো-অর্ডিনেশন।
skills.tech: Co-host Delegation, Panelist Direct Join Links, Backstage Video Chat
skills.spoken: I manage backstage logistics, panelist technical dry-runs, and instant co-host privilege delegation.
skills.interview_q: What happens if the primary host loses internet connection during a live 1,000-person webinar?
skills.interview_a: An assigned alternative co-host immediately inherits full host privileges without interrupting the broadcast.

skills.title: Automated Webinar Reminders
skills.summary: Configuring automated 1-week, 1-day, 1-hour, and 15-minute countdown reminders.
skills.bangla: ১ সপ্তাহ, ১ দিন, ১ ঘণ্টা ও ১৫ মিনিট আগের অটোমেটিক এসএমএস এবং ইমেইল কাউন্টডাউন রিমাইন্ডার।
skills.tech: Zoom Native Reminder Engine, Twilio SMS API, SendGrid, ActiveCampaign Sequences
skills.spoken: I configure multi-channel SMS and email reminder sequences that boost live attendance rates past 45%.
skills.interview_q: How do you increase webinar show-up rates from the industry average of 25% to over 45%?
skills.interview_a: By combining Zoom native reminders with 15-minute SMS nudges containing 1-click personalized join links via Twilio.

skills.title: Webinar Email Notifications
skills.summary: Customizing HTML invitation, registration confirmation, cancellation, and thank-you emails.
skills.bangla: কাস্টম এইচটিএমএল কনফার্মেশন, ক্যালেন্ডার ICS অ্যাটাচমেন্ট ও ফলো-আপ নোটিফিকেশন।
skills.tech: Dynamic ICS Calendar Generator, Liquid Email Templates, DKIM/SPF Custom Sender
skills.spoken: I customize Zoom transactional emails with one-click Google/Outlook calendar invites (.ics).
skills.interview_q: How do you prevent Zoom automated confirmation emails from landing in spam or promotions folders?
skills.interview_a: By configuring custom DKIM and SPF sender signatures in Zoom Admin for the corporate email domain.

skills.title: Webinar Attendance Tracking
skills.summary: Logging precise join times, leave times, minutes attended, and attendance percentage per lead.
skills.bangla: ইউজারের জয়েন টাইম, লিভ টাইম এবং মোট কত মিনিট উপস্থিত ছিলেন তা রিয়েলটাইম ক্যাপচার করা।
skills.tech: Participant API, Attendance Webhooks, Zoom Report Center, CSV Streamer
skills.spoken: I track minute-by-minute attendee duration to score prospect buying intent and segment leads.
skills.interview_q: How do you identify webinar leads who watched more than 80% of your presentation?
skills.interview_a: By polling the Webinar Participant Report endpoint and filtering `user_duration >= (webinar_duration * 0.8)` for CRM routing.

skills.title: Webinar Engagement Analytics
skills.summary: Analyzing poll responses, Q&A upvotes, chat logs, and attendee attentiveness scores.
skills.bangla: লাইভ পোল রেসপন্স, চ্যাট লগ অ্যানালাইসিস ও বায়ারদের এনগেজমেন্ট স্কোরের হিটম্যাপ তৈরি।
skills.tech: Zoom Poll Reports, Q&A Transcripts, Engagement API, Looker Studio Connector
skills.spoken: I extract live poll and Q&A interactions into analytics dashboards to gauge buyer interest.
skills.interview_q: How do you utilize live poll responses to trigger automated sales follow-up calls?
skills.interview_a: Poll responses exported via API feed into CRM tags, triggering immediate Slack notifications to account executives.

skills.title: Webinar Replay Automation
skills.summary: Gated on-demand replay rooms with automatic registration capture and CRM tagging.
skills.bangla: অন-ডিমান্ড ওয়েবিনার রিপ্লে ফানেল, গেটেড অ্যাক্সেস ও পুনরায় সেলস সিকোয়েন্স ট্রিগারিং।
skills.tech: Zoom On-Demand Recording, Wistia/Vimeo Sync, EverWebinar, HubSpot Replay Workflow
skills.spoken: I build automated evergreen on-demand replay funnels that capture and score leads 24/7.
skills.interview_q: How do you automatically send webinar replays only to registered leads who missed the live call?
skills.interview_a: We segment CRM contacts who have the tag `webinar_registered` but lack `webinar_attended` via post-event webhooks.

skills.title: Virtual Event Management
skills.summary: End-to-end technical production of full-day virtual conferences and sponsor summits.
skills.bangla: ফুল-ডে ভার্চুয়াল কনফারেন্স, লাইভ স্ট্রিম সুইচিং ও স্পন্সর বুথ টেকনিক্যাল ডিরেকশন।
skills.tech: vMix / OBS Integration, NDI Video Feeds, Zoom ISO, Live Audio Mastering
skills.spoken: I serve as technical director for virtual summits, routing high-bitrate NDI feeds into Zoom ISO.
skills.interview_q: How do you ingest multi-camera broadcast quality feeds into Zoom for a keynote speaker?
skills.interview_a: We use OBS or vMix via Virtual Camera and Zoom ISO to pipe high-definition isolated 1080p feeds with custom audio mixing.

skills.title: Zoom REST API
skills.summary: Full mastery of Zoom API v2 architecture, rate limits, pagination, and error codes.
skills.bangla: জুম রেস্ট এপিআই v2 স্ট্রাকচার, রেট লিমিট হ্যান্ডলিং ও পেজিনেশন ইঞ্জিনিয়ারিং।
skills.tech: REST API v2, Bearer Token Auth, Rate Limiter (Heavy/Medium/Light), HTTP 429 Retry
skills.spoken: I build resilient API services with exponential backoff to handle Zoom's heavy rate limit tiers.
skills.interview_q: How do you handle HTTP 429 Too Many Requests errors when making batch calls to Zoom API?
skills.interview_a: By reading the `Retry-After` header and implementing exponential backoff with jitter using a Redis task queue.

skills.title: Zoom OAuth Authentication
skills.summary: User-level OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow, refresh token rotation, and secure token storage.
skills.bangla: ইউজার-লেভেল OAuth 2.0 অথরাইজেশন কোড ফ্লো, রিফ্রেশ টোকেন রোটেশন ও ডাটাবেস এনক্রিপশন।
skills.tech: OAuth 2.0 RFC 6749, PKCE Flow, Refresh Token Rotation, AES-256 Storage
skills.spoken: I implement standard OAuth 2.0 with PKCE and automated refresh token rotation for multi-user apps.
skills.interview_q: Why is refresh token rotation critical in Zoom OAuth integrations?
skills.interview_a: Zoom invalidates old refresh tokens upon single use; apps must store the newly issued refresh token atomically to prevent auth failure.

skills.title: Zoom Server-to-Server OAuth
skills.summary: Replacing deprecated JWT apps with modern Server-to-Server OAuth for secure backend automation.
skills.bangla: JWT-এর আধুনিক বিকল্প: অ্যাকাউন্ট-লেভেল Server-to-Server OAuth দিয়ে সুরক্ষিত অটোমেশন।
skills.tech: Server-to-Server OAuth, Account ID, Client ID, Client Secret, Token Cache
skills.spoken: I configure modern Server-to-Server OAuth applications to power headless enterprise automation.
skills.interview_q: How do you authenticate backend microservices with Zoom without requiring any user login?
skills.interview_a: Using Server-to-Server OAuth: I POST client credentials and Account ID to `https://zoom.us/oauth/token?grant_type=account_credentials`.

skills.title: Zoom Webhooks
skills.summary: Webhook event subscriptions, secret token validation (CRC check), and event-driven pipelines.
skills.bangla: রিয়েল-টাইম ইভেন্ট সাবস্ক্রিপশন, সিক্রেট টোকেন HMAC-SHA256 CRC ভ্যালিডেশন।
skills.tech: Zoom Webhooks v2, HMAC-SHA256 Challenge-Response, Event Subscriptions
skills.spoken: I validate Zoom webhook challenge-response CRC checks with HMAC-SHA256 signatures.
skills.interview_q: How does Zoom's Webhook Challenge-Response Check (CRC) verification work?
skills.interview_a: When subscribing, Zoom sends a `plainToken`; the webhook endpoint must compute an HMAC-SHA256 hash using the Webhook Secret Token and return JSON.

skills.title: Meeting API Integration
skills.summary: Programmatically creating, updating, and deleting meetings with dynamic passcodes and hosts.
skills.bangla: কোডের মাধ্যমে স্বয়ংক্রিয়ভাবে মিটিং তৈরি, আপডেট ও হোস্ট ডিলিগেশন হ্যান্ডলিং।
skills.tech: POST /v2/users/{userId}/meetings, Patch Meeting, Meeting Passcode Policy
skills.spoken: I integrate meeting creation endpoints into client booking portals for instant calendar generation.
skills.interview_q: What payload parameters are mandatory when generating a secure Zoom meeting via API?
skills.interview_a: `topic`, `type` (usually 2 for scheduled), `start_time`, `duration`, `timezone`, `password`, and `settings: {waiting_room: true}`.

skills.title: Webinar API Integration
skills.summary: Automating webinar scheduling, panelist creation, and custom Q&A configuration via code.
skills.bangla: এপিআই দিয়ে ওয়েবিনার সিডিউলিং, প্যানেলিস্ট ইনভাইট পাঠানো ও লাইভ স্ট্রিম কী কনফিগারেশন।
skills.tech: POST /v2/users/{userId}/webinars, POST /v2/webinars/{id}/panelists
skills.spoken: I automate high-volume webinar scheduling and panelist credential delivery via Node.js scripts.
skills.interview_q: How do you add multiple external panelists to a Zoom webinar programmatically?
skills.interview_a: By calling `POST /v2/webinars/{webinarId}/panelists` with an array of objects containing `name` and `email`.

skills.title: Registrant API Integration
skills.summary: Pushing leads into Zoom webinars from external forms and receiving unique attendee join URLs.
skills.bangla: এক্সটার্নাল ওয়েবসাইট থেকে সরাসরি রেজিস্ট্র্যান্ট এপিআই-এ লিড পুশ করে ইউনিক লিংক নেওয়া।
skills.tech: POST /v2/webinars/{id}/registrants, Unique `join_url`, Custom Question Answers
skills.spoken: I pipe external landing page submissions directly to Zoom to generate personalized `join_url` tokens.
skills.interview_q: What is returned in the API response when you successfully register an attendee for a webinar?
skills.interview_a: The `registrant_id`, approval `status`, and the attendee's personalized `join_url` containing their secure session token.
